title: Xbox Nano features hidden direct Wi-Fi cloud connectivity
excerpt: Microsoft's upcoming Xbox Nano controller includes a previously unannounced feature enabling direct Wi-Fi connection to Xbox Cloud Gaming.
body_html:
Microsoft is preparing to release the new Xbox Nano controller, which includes an unannounced feature allowing it to connect directly to Xbox Cloud Gaming over Wi-Fi. This capability is designed to help improve latency during cloud gaming sessions.

While Microsoft has not officially promoted this functionality prior to the device's launch, the direct Wi-Fi connectivity option was anticipated following earlier leaks of the hardware.
